::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_instructions"}
#docs
Printed on invoices; see the Documents settings for whether they are sent at all.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of payment instruction, such as a bank transfer. One of `bank_transfer`, `paypal`. |
| `section_title` | `string` | **yes** | The heading of the section. |
| `section_id` | `string` | no | The merchant's own reference for this block. Theirs, opaque to us. |
| `description` | `string` | no | PLAIN TEXT. Printed into a customer-facing PDF and HTML view, so markup would be an injection surface. |
| `fields` | `array of object` | no | The label/value list a bank block is printed from (Account name, IFSC, SWIFT …). Ordered, merchant-defined, never parsed by us. |
| `fields.label` | `string` | **yes** | The label of the line, e.g. `Account number`. |
| `fields.value` | `string` | **yes** | The value of the line. |
| `currencies` | `array of string` | no | Empty (the default) applies to every invoice; a non-empty list narrows to these. |
| `countries` | `array of string` | no | Empty (the default) applies to every invoice; a non-empty list narrows to these. |
| `position` | `integer` | no | The section's sort position; lower numbers come first. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body, or too many fields |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_instructions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "kind": "bank_transfer",
    "section_title": "Bank transfer",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs."
  }'
```
